title: S1Ge GATED: the S1 >= side atom - the walk's zero-side leg at its pointwise core (|zeta - K| >= devW - Mval from A0 + reverse triangle + the A4.3 mass premise) - and S31Z2 dps-20/dps-30 LANDED in AGREEMENT (logzeta = +1.7289704098 at both): dps-15 was the outlier
body: FORMAL MILESTONE: formal/RhAttack/S1Ge.lean is green.  THE ATOM: s1_ge_side states the S1 (zero-side) leg of the walk spine at its pointwise core: with the finite-kernel gap |K - (P_n(s) - I(n,s))| <= Mval (the A4.3-wired mass bound, wired in the tree by P8Floor p8_residual_wired under the mass premise |x| <= Xval) and the deviation face devW below the zero-side kernel magnitude |W_n(s)|, the zero-side fill |zeta(s) - K| (the A0 same object |def - zero|, P8Floor p8_same_object) dominates devW - Mval.  The proof is pure composition over named atoms: hobj = p8_same_object (A0: W_n - (K - (P_n - I)) = zeta - K, DLMF 25.2.12 bridge in bare algebraic form); htri = the REVERSE triangle: W_n = (zeta - K) + r hence |W_n| <= |zeta - K| + |r| (norm_add_le); then linarith over the four linear facts (devW <= |W_n|, |r| <= Mval, the reverse triangle) yields |zeta - K| >= devW - Mval - the subtraction bookkeeping devW - Mval <= |W_n| - Mval <= |W_n| - |r| <= |zeta - K|.  SPEC STATUS: the P1.2 spec's S1 row records this leg as 'LEAN-PROVEN POINTWISE under the mass premise |x| <= Xval(band)' with 'bridge zeta = kernel (DLMF 25.2.12, CITED) + b3 BSBAR explicit wire (A4.3 p8_residual_wired)' - S1Ge is exactly that proven pointwise row (the C2 >= side of the closure spec's atom table); the OPEN part the spec names (uniformity of the premise in the height) is the measured track (25x/25y: the P1.1e margin regime from ~5.6e7 upward) and is NOT claimed.  HONESTY: LEAN-PROVEN (the composition, this module); CITED upstream (the A2c bridge |W_n| = |em_expr| through which the dev face reads |W_n| - DLMF 25.2.8 / Apostol Thm 12.21).  NO RH claim: the hs1 leg of the endpoint remains a named residual supported face-by-face by the data program; this module is the pointwise atom the low-band and audit-band hs1 faces instantiate.  FULL TREE BUILD GREEN 17450.  DATA (5e8G ladder, the last reachable mpmath height, t = 1.5000523e19, N_terms = 1.5451e9): dps-20 LANDED (logzeta = +1.7289704098, 4506.3 s, peak 92.6 GB) and dps-30 LANDED (logzeta = +1.7289704098 - DIGIT-IDENTICAL to dps-20, 4700.2 s, peak 95.1 GB).  The dps-15 value (+2.9370199551, peak 92.6 GB) is now adjudicated the OUTLIER - a precision artifact of dps-15 at ~1.5e9 Riemann-Siegel terms; the emerging STABLE value at 5e8G is log|zeta| ~ +1.729 (|zeta| ~ 5.64).  dps-40 (the census working channel) is in flight (fresh process, ~20 min in of ~80 expected); if it lands (as expected, agreeing to dps-20/30), the staggered row protocol (s32a non-zeta channels + s32b merge) locks the verified extreme boundary at 1.5e19 - the last mpmath-reachable row on this 124 GB machine; if it OOMs, 9e18 stands and the remaining levers are a C zeta channel or more RAM.  No RH claim anywhere.
